title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Statistics
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: In statistics out of 100, the marks of 21 students in final exams are as 90, 95, 95, 94, 90, 85, 84, 83, 85, 81, 92, 93, 82, 78, 79, 81, 80, 82, 85, 76, 85, then the mode of data is:
questions.explain: The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. Counting the frequencies of the given marks, the number 85 appears 4 times, which is more than any other score. Thus, the mode is 85.
